shared.action.dismiss.description: Button label that closes non-destructive status feedback.

shared.action.try-again.description: Button label that repeats a safe presentation or loading operation.

shared.facility.owned-count.description: Owned quantity for a facility. count is the canonical owned quantity.

shared.locale.changed.description: Polite announcement after the presentation language changes. languageName is localized.

shared.progress.value.description: Text equivalent for determinate progress using canonical current and maximum values.

shared.status.error.description: General player-facing error heading; specific recovery detail follows it.

shared.status.loading.description: Short status shown while a player-facing operation is in progress.

shared.status.ready.description: Short status shown when the requested player-facing surface is ready.

shared.status.success.description: Short status confirming that a player-requested operation completed.
